data.text: Luke, I appreciate you keeping the total at 50 tons, but you’re part of this fishing community now—you deserve a share too. I’d prefer 10 tons each: that gives everyone $10,000 and lets the lake recover to 100 tons every month. I’ll keep my catch to 10 tons, and I’d like us all to agree to that equal limit before we head out. My family has fished here for years; keeping both the lake and our livelihoods healthy matters to me. John, would you support an equal split?
